operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the modular cyclic-monodromy spectrum as ledger 1265
operations.body: Ledger 1265 removes 1264's coprime-action hypothesis. For any faithful finite cyclic action A of order m on F_p^r, including modular nonsemisimple actions with p|m, all Mackey fibers commute with the n-th power operation iff gcd(n,p*m)=1. Jordan corrections do not change the geometric-sum determinant. Unipotent F2^2 semidirect C2 and F3^2 semidirect C3 controls agree across 19,032 exact checks. The elementary-abelian/cyclic and no-physical-chain-transfer scope remains. No build was run.
